mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in tightening periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower in tightening labor market periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in strong economic expansion periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in economic expansion periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real GDP by more than 2% month-over-month and quarter-over-quarter respectively signals strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 2% in 1 month AND GDPC1 increases > 2% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher in strong economic expansion periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening economic conditions, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in economic contraction periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressures, which erodes real returns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower in inflationary periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in retail sales and housing starts by more than 1% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month AND HOUST increases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in strong consumer demand periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
